text:
Asha Kumar: Heads-up 2h trend looks weird on the campaign dashboard. paid clicks up 2.5x after the launch post but webinar signups per click down ~55%. https://redwood.app/dashboards/weekly-kpis :confused:
dash-bot: ALERT: attribution shift detected for campaign 'launch-mar-2026' - last_click vs first_click mismatch > 30% (auto-check). Details: https://redwood.app/alerts/2219
Ben Torres: is this last-touch vs data-driven? check the dashboard attribution setting, we accidentally flipped to last_click for the email resend on 3/18 in the viz. might explain the jump.
Nina Park: also seeing fewer demo requests in the CRM import. GA shows sessions -> signups at 1.8% but ingest shows 0.8%. Could be missing utm_source on some creative variants.
Evan Cho: quick SQL to cross-check CRM vs ingestion:
```
SELECT source, count(*) as leads
FROM marketing.leads_v2
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY leads DESC
```
Result snapshot: organic_newsletter 312, paid_search 248, launch-email 94. Last week launch-email was 210.
Asha Kumar: Thanks. Ben can you confirm what attribution model the dashboard uses? Nina can you fetch the GTM event list for the iframe? Evan, is the CRM import lagging?
Ben Torres: dashboard was set to "last_click" for the weekly snapshot. changing to "data_driven" makes launch-email drop from 29% to 12% of conversions. that aligns with the idea that paid search assisted many conversions.
Nina Park: GTM events show event name `form_submit` firing, but some variants miss `utm_campaign` in the dataset. two creatives had malformed links (missing utm_medium). saving the list to: https://redwood.app/files/gtm-march-resend.csv
Evan Cho: CRM import had a stalled job on 3/19 at 03:12 UTC due to a schema mismatch (phone_number length). I restarted import and queued a reprocess for 3/15-3/20. ETA for reprocessed metrics ~3h.
Asha Kumar: plan: 1) Ben toggle dashboard to data_driven and re-generate snapshot for Monday KPI email; 2) Nina to correct GTM links and push a small fix for the malformed UTMs; 3) Evan to finish reprocess and confirm lead counts. We'll hold attribution commentary in this week's deck until numbers stable.
Ben Torres: doing the dashboard toggle now, will post before EOD.
Nina Park: submitting GTM fixes in a PR -> https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/489.
Evan Cho: reprocess started. job 707 status: running. will update thread on completion.
dash-bot: REPROCESS job 707 started by Evan Cho. ETA ~3h.
Asha Kumar: perfect. I'll add a slide to the weekly KPI deck noting attribution model sensitivity and list the pending reprocess. Monday sync will decide messaging. :memo:
